review.shorterRoute: Investigate restriction to the already proved Gamma1(M) and original Gamma0(d*M) fields to separate generic intersection orbits. Then use fixed j-fiber degree and the native termwise ramification bound to force all-fiber orbit separation and exact ramification. Avoid redeveloping integral modular-form separation for the intersection subgroup.
review.assumptionsToDischarge: Actual original Gamma0 field inclusion and unchanged germs; generic intersection orbit identification; exact j degree; all-fiber orbit bijection; exact stabilizer normalization including elliptic points. No orbit, degree or ramification premise remains beyond actual subgroup, nonzero levels and translation membership.
review.caution: Gamma1 and Gamma0 orbit equalities alone do not imply intersection orbit equality at elliptic points. The generic stabilizer condition is essential in the first step; all-point equality still needs the degree argument.
